tools.name: search_metadata
tools.description: Creates a prompt for Searching metadata in OpenMetadata.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default is 10. Try to keep this number low unless the user asks for more.

tools.name: ownership_stewardship
tools.description: Guides a data steward through the 3-step ownership assignment workflow: find unowned assets, suggest best owners, and draft review-ready ownership patches. Use this when the user wants to identify and fix governance gaps (assets without owners).

arguments.name: entityType
arguments.description: Entity type to search for unowned assets. Default is 'table'.

arguments.name: scope
arguments.description: Optional scope filter — a domain name string (shorthand) or {type, value} object with type 'domain' or 'service'.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Maximum number of unowned assets to return. Default is 25, maximum is 200.
